The corrupted stochastic environment with C = sum |c_t| and a unique optimal arm is stated as an assumption. The non-linear corruption and the noise caveat are correctly put in unmapped.
The registry id ftrl_linear_negentropy_g_optimal matches Algorithm 1 (FTRL with negative entropy and G-optimal design mixing).
Matches the adversarial bullet of thm:thmregret, O(sqrt(dT ln T ln(|D|T))). R(T) is the expected pseudo-regret against the best arm in expectation. The horizon is known because beta_t uses ln T.
Matches the corrupted-stochastic bullet: O(d ln T ln(|D|T)/Delta_min + sqrt(C d ln T ln(|D|T)/Delta_min)). The setting and conditions are correct.
